verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a Platform API 'Audiences' page and a 'Real-time API to drive user personalization', which suggests some programmatic audience and profile access. However, the only documented activation flow is dashboard-driven ('Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory'), and there is no MCP evidence. missing for 10: evidence that audiences can be created and defined via API, API-based connection of audiences to outputs, documented profile query details, an MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop

citations.quote: Real-time API to drive user personalization
